media.title: France Aka M Lebrun Re-Elected (1939)
media.evidence: FALLBACK newsreel (no radio found). oEmbed 200, author 'British Pathé' (official channel); description: 'politicians cheering and clapping inside the National Assembly building as the announcement is made of the President Albert Lebrun re-election'. Exact release date not stated (April 1939).
